name: source_object
description: GCS object path containing the source SCHEDULE publication.

name: source_generation
description: GCS generation identifying the exact physical version of the source object.

name: publication_sequence
description: Network Rail publication sequence number used to identify and order SCHEDULE publications.

name: extract_type
description: SCHEDULE extract type from the publication metadata; expected values are 'full' or 'update'.

name: transaction_type
description: Source transaction type for the schedule record; expected values are 'Create' or 'Delete'. Full extracts are expected to contain only 'Create' records.

name: CIF_stp_indicator
description: Short-term planning indicator: `C` STP cancellation of a permanent schedule, `N` new STP schedule, `O` STP overlay, or `P` permanent schedule.

name: CIF_train_uid
description: CIF train UID identifying the scheduled service family. In this dataset, 'train' refers to a scheduled service rather than a physical rolling-stock asset. Multiple schedule records may share a UID across dates or STP variants.

name: schedule_start_date
description: First date on which this schedule record applies. Present on 'Create' and 'Delete' records.

name: schedule_end_date
description: Last date on which this schedule record applies. Present on 'Create' records and omitted on 'Delete' records.

name: CIF_bank_holiday_running
description: CIF bank-holiday running code used for timetable presentation. Present on 'Create' records, commonly null, and omitted on 'Delete' records.

name: schedule_days_runs
description: Seven-character Monday-to-Sunday running-day mask, where `1` means the service runs on that day. Present on 'Create' records and omitted on 'Delete' records.

name: train_status
description: CIF train-status code describing the type/status of the scheduled service. Present on 'Create' records and omitted on 'Delete' records.

name: atoc_code
description: ATOC code identifying the train operator. Present on full `P`/`O`/`N` 'Create' schedules and omitted on cancellation-style 'Create' records and 'Delete' records.

name: applicable_timetable
description: Indicates whether the service is an Applicable Timetable Service for performance monitoring. Present on full `P`/`O`/`N` 'Create' schedules and omitted on cancellation-style 'Create' records and 'Delete' records.

name: new_schedule_segment
description: Additional schedule details derived from the CIF Basic Schedule Extra Details (BX) record. Present on full `P`/`O`/`N` 'Create' schedules and omitted on cancellation-style 'Create' records and 'Delete' records.

fields.name: traction_class
fields.description: Legacy CIF traction-class field. Documented by Network Rail as not used and often supplied as an empty string. Blank-to-null normalisation is deferred to staging.

fields.name: uic_code
fields.description: UIC (Union Internationale des Chemins de Fer) service code, principally relevant to international services and often supplied as an empty string. Blank-to-null normalisation is deferred to staging.

name: schedule_segment
description: Service attributes and ordered timing locations for the schedule. Present on 'Create' records, including cancellation-style 'Create' records, and omitted on 'Delete' records. Cancellation-style 'Create' records omit schedule_location.

fields.name: signalling_id
fields.description: Operational signalling ID, commonly referred to as the train headcode. May be an empty string for services without a published signalling ID.

fields.name: CIF_business_sector
fields.description: CIF business sector field. Historically represented the business sector; now used as the portion ID for services which join or split.

fields.name: CIF_course_indicator
fields.description: Legacy CIF course indicator. Documented by Network Rail as not used.

fields.name: CIF_headcode
fields.description: National Reservation System headcode designated by the train operator; distinct from signalling_id. May be an empty string.

fields.name: CIF_train_category
fields.description: CIF train category code describing the broad type of service.

fields.name: CIF_service_branding
fields.description: CIF service-branding code. Often blank; `E` denotes Eurostar in the published code set.

fields.name: CIF_train_service_code
fields.description: Train service code used to group scheduled services and for railway revenue/accounting purposes. Here, 'train' refers to a scheduled service rather than a physical rolling-stock asset.

fields.name: CIF_connection_indicator
fields.description: Legacy CIF connection indicator. Documented by Network Rail as not used and observed null in the profiled full extract.

fields.name: CIF_sleepers
fields.description: Code indicating sleeper accommodation where applicable; otherwise null.

fields.name: CIF_catering_code
fields.description: One or more CIF catering codes describing onboard catering provision; otherwise null.

fields.name: CIF_reservations
fields.description: CIF reservation code describing reservation availability or requirements; otherwise null.

fields.name: CIF_operating_characteristics
fields.description: Up to six CIF operating-characteristic codes applying to the service; otherwise null.

fields.name: CIF_timing_load
fields.description: CIF timing-load code used in timetable planning to represent service performance characteristics; otherwise null.

fields.name: CIF_train_class
fields.description: Passenger accommodation class code; otherwise null.

fields.name: CIF_power_type
fields.description: CIF power-type code describing the traction type used for timetable planning; otherwise null.

fields.name: CIF_speed
fields.description: Planned speed of the service as carried in the CIF schedule; otherwise null.

fields.name: schedule_location
fields.description: Ordered timing locations forming the schedule. Full `P`/`O`/`N` 'Create' schedules contain locations; cancellation-style 'Create' records and 'Delete' records do not.

fields.name: location_type
fields.description: Location record type: `LO` origin, `LI` intermediate, or `LT` terminus. Mirrors record_identity in this feed.

fields.name: record_identity
fields.description: CIF location record identity: `LO` origin, `LI` intermediate, or `LT` terminus.

fields.name: tiploc_code
fields.description: TIPLOC code identifying this schedule location.

fields.name: tiploc_instance
fields.description: Occurrence suffix used to distinguish repeated visits to the same TIPLOC within a schedule. Usually null.

fields.name: platform
fields.description: Planned platform or line identifier at the location, where supplied.

fields.name: arrival
fields.description: Working Timetable arrival time at intermediate or terminating locations, in local railway time as HHMM with optional `H` for a half-minute. Omitted where arrival is not applicable.

fields.name: departure
fields.description: Working Timetable departure time at originating or intermediate locations, in local railway time as HHMM with optional `H` for a half-minute. Omitted where departure is not applicable.

fields.name: pass
fields.description: Working Timetable passing time for an intermediate timing point, in local railway time as HHMM with optional `H` for a half-minute. Omitted for locations with arrival/departure activity.

fields.name: public_arrival
fields.description: Passenger-facing public arrival time at intermediate or terminating locations, in local time as HHMM. Omitted where not applicable or not published.

fields.name: public_departure
fields.description: Passenger-facing public departure time at originating or intermediate locations, in local time as HHMM. Omitted where not applicable or not published.

fields.name: path
fields.description: Planned arrival path or line abbreviation at the location, where supplied.

fields.name: line
fields.description: Planned departure line abbreviation at the location, where supplied.

fields.name: engineering_allowance
fields.description: Additional schedule time allowed for recovery from engineering activities, expressed in whole or half minutes.

fields.name: pathing_allowance
fields.description: Additional schedule time allowed for pathing requirements, expressed in whole or half minutes.

fields.name: performance_allowance
fields.description: Performance allowance added to the schedule, expressed in whole or half minutes.
